{"code":"local function resolve(attacker, defender, skill)
  local atk = attacker.atk
  local alevel = attacker.level
  local cc = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local cm = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pp = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pf = attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local hp = defender.hp
  local sh = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor
  local dlevel = defender.level
  local delem = defender.element
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding or false
  local power = skill.power
  local selem = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local td = skill.true_damage or false
  local seed = skill.seed or 0
  local MT = {
    physical = {fire=100, water=100, nature=100, neutral=100, ghost=0},
    fire = {fire=50, water=50, nature=200, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    water = {fire=200, water=50, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100},
    nature = {fire=50, water=200, nature=50, neutral=100, ghost=100}
  }
  local row = MT[selem] or MT.physical
  local m = row[delem]
  if m == nil then m = 100 end
  local diff = alevel - dlevel
  if diff > 10 then diff = 10 elseif diff < -10 then diff = -10 end
  local lmult = 100 + 3*diff
  local r = resist[selem] or 0
  if r > 80 then r = 80 elseif r < -50 then r = -50 end
  local damage = 0
  local absorbed = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local killed = false
  for k = 1, hits do
    if hp <= 0 then break end
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local p = power - 20*(k-1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)
    d = math.floor(d * lmult / 100)
    local iscrit = ((seed + 17*k) % 100) < cc
    if iscrit then
      crits = crits + 1
      d = math.floor(d * cm / 100)
    end
    if not td then
      local pen = pp
      if iscrit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pf
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
      d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
      d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    end
    if guarding then d = math.floor(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 then
      if (not td) and m == 0 then d = 0 else d = 1 end
    end
    local a = math.min(sh, d)
    sh = sh - a
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and sh == 0 then loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100) end
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end
  return {damage = defender.hp - hp, absorbed = absorbed, hp = hp, shield = sh, overkill = overkill, crits = crits, hits = resolved, killed = killed}
end
local function ser(t)
  local ks = {'damage','absorbed','hp','shield','overkill','crits','hits','killed'}
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #ks do out[#out+1] = ks[i] .. '=' .. tostring(t[ks[i]]) end
  return '{' .. table.concat(out, ',') .. '}'
end
local r1 = ser(resolve({atk=40,level=12,crit_chance=30,crit_mult=150,pen_pct=25,pen_flat=5},{hp=60,shield=10,armor=40,level=10,element='nature',resist={fire=20},guarding=false},{power=120,element='fire',hits=2,true_damage=false,seed=3}))
local r2 = ser(resolve({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40}))
local r3 = ser(resolve({atk=10,level=1},{hp=5,armor=0,level=1,element='ghost'},{power=0}))
local ok, err = pcall(logic_define, 'resolve_attack', resolve)
return r1 .. ' | ' .. r2 .. ' | ' .. r3 .. ' | def=' .. tostring(ok) .. ':' .. tostring(err)"}
